dcterms:description: A multiplex network describing how physicians in four towns in Illinois used the new drug tetracycline, composed of 3 layers corresponding to three questions asked to the physicians.
dcterms:title: CKM physician innovation

dcterms:description: A multiplex social network composed of 3 layers based on co-working, friendship, and advice between partners and associates of a corporate law partnership.
dcterms:title: Lazega network

dcterms:description: A neuronal multiplex network composed of 3 layers corresponding to different synaptic junctions: electrical, chemical poladic, and chemical monadic.
dcterms:title: Caenorabidis Elegans connectome

dcterms:description: A multiplex network composed of 8 layers corresponding to different ArXiv categories, restricted to papers with 'networks' in the title or abstract.
dcterms:title: ArXiv network

dcterms:description: A multiplex network composed of 4 layers extracted from the original network on CoMuNe Lab, keeping physical association, direct interaction, association, and co-localization layers.
dcterms:title: Homo sapiens network

dcterms:description: A multiplex network composed of 3 layers: a disease-disease network based on a projection of a disease-drug network, a disease-disease network based on shared symptoms, and a comorbidity network from epidemiological data.
dcterms:title: Disease multiplex network

dcterms:description: A molecular network consisting of 3 layers: a protein-protein interaction layer, a pathways layer extracted from Reactome data, and a molecular complexes layer constructed from various datasets.
dcterms:title: Human molecular multiplex network

dcterms:description: A gene-disease multiplex-heterogeneous network constructed from two multiplex networks and a curated gene-disease bipartite network, containing interactions between diseases and genes.
dcterms:title: Gene-disease multiplex-heterogeneous network

dcterms:description: A drug-target multiplex-heterogeneous network constructed from a molecular multiplex network and a drug-target bipartite network, containing interactions between drugs and protein targets.
dcterms:title: Drug-target multiplex-heterogeneous network
